thread:
alex (PM): Quick heads-up — I just published the post-incident writeup for today's degraded routing incident. TL;DR: routing table mis-sync + healthcheck TTL mismatch caused intermittent 503s for dedicated pods. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/l/c/DEG-2026-routing-summary
ops-bot: Incident DEG-2026-Routing marked RESOLVED at 14:02 UTC. Duration ~47m.
carmen (Eng): Short timeline: 13:10 saw spike in 502/503, autoscaler started evicting pods at 13:17 due to failed healthchecks, control-plane routing updates lagged (13:20-13:30) while we drained nodes.
raj (SRE): Root cause: healthcheck TTL set to 1s in rollout config; under short CPU stalls probes flapped -> autoscaler treated pods as unhealthy. Secondary issue: control-plane backpressure delayed routing updates.
emily (Support): 25 customers reported errors via status page; we sent proactive message at 13:40. No data exfiltration.
lauren (VP Ops): Great work on the timeline and comms. Please highlight action items and owners.
alex (PM): Action items (from the doc):
• A1 — Lock TTL to >=5s for healthchecks and add CI validation (@carmen) — due 2026-03-27
• A2 — Autoscaler sensitivity audit + default thresholds (@raj) — due 2026-04-03
• A3 — Add routing-sync backoff metrics + alert (@eng-monitoring) — owner: SRE oncall rotation — due 2026-03-30
• A4 — Post-incident customer note template + follow-up outreach (@emily) — due 2026-03-25
• A5 — Canary rollout to include probe flapping simulation (@carmen, @raj) — due 2026-04-10
carmen (Eng): PRs opened: infra#1427 (fix TTL), infra#1428 (CI probe test). Link: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/1427
raj (SRE): I've scheduled a checkpoint: 2026-03-29 16:00 UTC to review A1-A3. Calendar invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abc123
alex (PM): Please add short status updates to the doc before the checkpoint; I tagged owners in the tracker.
ops-bot: New checklist items added to DEG-2026 routing tracker. :white_check_mark:
emily (Support): I'll draft the customer follow-up and share in #customer-success for review.
lauren (VP Ops): Prioritization note: A1 and A3 are P0. Anything that delays those, escalate.
carmen (Eng): Noted. Planning a hotfix deployment tomorrow 09:00 PT.
raj (SRE): Will monitor post-deploy for 48h and bump alerts thresholds for flapping. :eyes:
alex (PM): Thanks everyone — thread contains the official record, I'll pin the doc to the channel. If you have updates, reply in-thread. :thumbsup:
emily (Support): Thanks! :heart:
lauren (VP Ops): Closing note — good cross-team collaboration. Let's tighten the runbooks based on this.
